User.title: User
User.description: Public user profile with role, XP, and vote weight for the music review platform.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user.

displayName.description: Display name shown in chat and reviews.

avatarUrl.description: URL to the user avatar image.

xp.description: Experience points earned from active participation and accurate reviews.

level.description: Calculated user level based on XP.

voteWeight.description: Multiplier weight of the user's vote in community score calculation (e.g. 1.0 to 10.0).

reviewsCount.description: Total number of track reviews submitted by the user.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the profile was last updated.

CriteriaScores.title: CriteriaScores
CriteriaScores.description: 5-parameter evaluation matrix (1 to 10) for music tracks.

production.description: Beat, mixing, and sound design score (1-10).

vibe.description: Overall atmosphere and replay value score (1-10).

Track.title: Track
Track.description: Music track submitted for live stream reaction and evaluation.

audioUrl.description: Direct audio stream URL or platform link.

sourceUrl.description: Original platform URL (SoundCloud, YouTube, Spotify, etc.).

submittedBy.description: UID of the user who submitted the track.

isPriority.description: Whether the track was submitted with priority/donation.

donationAmount.description: Donation amount attached to the submission.

status.description: Current lifecycle status of the track in the stream queue or catalog.

expertTotalScore.description: Calculated total/average score from experts (1-10 or 0-100).

communityScore.description: Weighted average 5-parameter scores from the community.

communityTotalScore.description: Calculated weighted total/average score from the community.

communityVotesCount.description: Total number of community votes cast for this track.

metaScore.description: Combined final MetaScore blending expertScore and communityScore.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the track was submitted.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the track was last updated.

LiveSession.title: LiveSession
LiveSession.description: Real-time stream state synchronized between host dashboard, viewers, and OBS browser overlay.

isLive.description: Whether the stream reaction session is currently active.

streamStatus.description: Current phase of the live reaction session.

activeTrackId.description: ID of the currently active track in tracks collection (or empty string if none).

hostId.description: UID of the streamer/host controlling the session.

votingOpen.description: Whether community voting is currently open for the active track.

isPlaying.description: Whether audio playback is currently running (for OBS sync).

playbackPosition.description: Current playback position in seconds for OBS widget synchronization.

showObsOverlay.description: Whether the OBS overlay widget should be visible on stream.

obsTheme.description: Visual theme preset for the OBS browser overlay.

liveExpertDraft.description: Real-time draft scores being adjusted by the host on stream.

viewersCount.description: Current number of active viewers in the session.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of the last state transition.

/users/{userId}.description: Public user profiles containing role, XP, and voteWeight.

/tracks/{trackId}.description: Submitted music tracks with expertScore, communityScore, metaScore, and queue status.

/tracks/{trackId}/reviews/{reviewId}.description: Community reviews and 5-parameter evaluations for a specific track.

/live_sessions/{sessionId}.description: Real-time stream state for OBS overlay and viewer synchronization.

/liveSessions/{sessionId}.description: Legacy alias for real-time stream state.
